summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Master Data Management, Permission Engine, and Franchise Owner Dashboard features. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend features verified working with minor UI note about sidebar category expansion.

issues: Franchise category requires click to expand even though it's in initial expandedCategories state - minor UX issue, functionality works correctly

master_types_endpoint.details: GET /api/masters/types returns 14 master type definitions with counts (expense_categories: 35 active, payment_modes: 8 active, employee_categories: 21 active, etc.)

master_crud_operations.details: POST /api/masters/{type}/list, /create, /update, /delete all working. Tested with expense_categories - create, update, soft-delete (deactivate) all successful.

seed_from_existing.details: POST /api/masters/seed-from-existing migrates existing data safely. Seeded expense categories from expense_heads, payment modes, employee categories from designations, tax configs, order types, cancellation reasons, sales channels, licenses, discount types, menu categories.

permission_roles_seed.details: POST /api/permissions/roles/seed-defaults creates 7 default roles: super_admin, admin, center_manager, super_manager, accountant, franchise_owner, staff

permission_roles_list.details: POST /api/permissions/roles/list returns all 7 seeded roles with permissions and scope

my_permissions_endpoint.details: GET /api/permissions/my-permissions returns correct role_key, role_name, permissions map, and scope for super admin (all_centers)

role_assignment.details: POST /api/permissions/roles/assign successfully assigns role_key to manager

expense_types_from_master.details: GET /api/sales/expense-types returns source=master when master_expense_categories has data

payment_modes_from_master.details: GET /api/sales/payment-modes returns source=master when master_payment_modes has data

master_data_page_ui.details: Master Data Management page loads with 14 master type cards showing counts. Clicking a card loads items in table. 'Seed from System' and 'Seed Roles' buttons present. Add button opens create dialog with Name, Description, Code fields.

franchise_owner_dashboard_ui.details: Franchise Owner Dashboard at /franchise-dashboard loads with KPI cards (Total Sales, Total Expenses, Net Profit, Margin), View Only badge, period selector, Export button, and 3 tabs (Sales Overview, Expense Breakdown, Franchise Info)

role_management_page_ui.details: Role Management page shows managers list with Edit Roles button. System Role section shows DB-driven role options when editing.

sidebar_navigation.details: Master Data visible under Management category. Owner Dashboard visible under Franchise category (requires expanding Franchise category).

seed_data_creation: Master data seeded via /api/masters/seed-from-existing: 35 expense categories, 8 payment modes, 21 employee categories, 3 tax configs, 7 menu categories, 4 order types, 6 cancellation reasons, 6 sales channels, 6 licenses, 5 discount types. 7 roles seeded via /api/permissions/roles/seed-defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master Data Management and Permission Engine fully working: 1) /api/masters/types returns 14 master types with counts, 2) Generic CRUD at /api/masters/{type}/list|create|update|delete, 3) /api/masters/seed-from-existing migrates existing data, 4) /api/permissions/roles/seed-defaults creates 7 roles, 5) /api/permissions/my-permissions returns user's role and permissions, 6) /api/sales/expense-types and /api/sales/payment-modes now return source=master, 7) Master Data page at /master-data, 8) Franchise Owner Dashboard at /franchise-dashboard, 9) Role Management shows DB-driven system roles. Sidebar Franchise category needs to be clicked to expand to see Owner Dashboard link.
